verdict.rationale: The Division's own NJ portal pages describe an online Business Formation service to 'file certificates of formation and authorization of business entities'. They also refer to the 'Business Formation online service' with a shared payment account for submitting filings, plus online tax/employer registration and online name reservation. Together these cover forming, registering and paying online. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that a formation filing and payment can be completed end-to-end online.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: You may use this streamlined service to file certificates of formation and authorization of business entities.
If your business frequently uses the Business Formation online service or needs to provide staff access to use a shared payment account to submit filings
File online to reserve a name for your future LLC, LLP, LP, Corporation or Non-profit organization
When you have already formed/authorized your business in NJ and need to register for tax and employer purposes
